album.AlbumPlot:
### "Vows of Silence" - The Shadow Civil War (Era I)
The 16-song saga of the two men who broke the universe. Centuries before the Great Darkness, the Fallen Seer **Acheron** discards the **Forbidden Tome**, believing he has evolved beyond his god. While he builds a secret vampire mafia in Eldoria, a young zealot named **Malakar** hunts for the discarded truth. This album chronicles their dimensional rivalry, the assassination of Acheron's physical form, and Malakar's rise as the Priest of the Void, ending at the moment the sky turns black.

Song.Plot: Acheron reflects on his decision to discard the Tome. He has founded the Crimson Covenant and realized that Nyktoros will eventually consume his 'children.' He begins the Vow of Silence to hide his energy-hoarding.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] I was a Seer of the silver light, Now I am master of the endless night. I threw the book into the ancient dust, I have no master, only hunger's trust. The high-frequency is starting to fade, By the dark choices that I have made.
[Chorus] Vows of silence, in the shadow's heart, We tear the fabric of the world apart. We feed in secret, we are the elite, While the Great Master stays in his retreat. Vows of silence, let the blood flow free, We are the masters of our destiny.
[Verse 2] The high-born Elves in their crystal halls, Cannot hear when the silence calls. I am the Apostate, the fallen son, The new world order has just begun. I feel the Thirst within the divine soul, Taking back the power and the control.
[Chorus] Vows of silence, in the shadow's heart, We tear the fabric of the world apart. We feed in secret, we are the elite, While the Great Master stays in his retreat. Vows of silence, let the blood flow free, We are the masters of our destiny.
[Bridge] Nyktoros is waking, I can feel the cold, But I have secrets that have not been told. I'll merge the starlight with the hollow gray, And find a power in a different way. He is the hunger, but I am the knife, Leeched from the marrow of the mortal life.
[Chorus] Vows of silence, in the shadow's heart, We tear the fabric of the world apart. We feed in secret, we are the elite, While the Great Master stays in his retreat. Vows of silence, let the blood flow free, We are the masters of our destiny.
[Outro] Keep the silence... Bank the souls... The Covenant is born. The Covenant is born.

Song.Plot: Malakar is introduced as a scholar-priest, hunting for the Tome and sensing the presence of the 'True Master' Nyktoros. He views Acheron's abandonment of the book as the ultimate sin.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] The air is hollow and the stars are thin, I feel the Master calling from within. The Night Elves suffer under petty kings, While in the deep, the ancient silence sings. I am the scholar of the sunless ways, Counting the numbers of the final days.
[Chorus] I am the disciple of the hidden door, Searching for the blueprints of the war. The High Elf thief has thrown the truth away, I'll find the darkness and I'll end the day. Disciple of shadow, faithful and cold, Bringing the era that was once foretold.
[Verse 2] The world is broken and the light is a lie, Beneath the surface of the empty sky. I feel the vibration of the dormant Void, The sacred balance has been destroyed. The Aurorians sleep in their beds of gold, Ignorant of the story that must be told.
[Chorus] I am the disciple of the hidden door, Searching for the blueprints of the war. The High Elf thief has thrown the truth away, I'll find the darkness and I'll end the day. Disciple of shadow, faithful and cold, Bringing the era that was once foretold.
[Bridge] Acheron is hiding in the world of light, He is a parasite within the night. But I am faithful, I am pure and true, I'll do the work that he refused to do. I'll find the key and I'll unlock the gate, And seal the physical and elven fate.
[Chorus] I am the disciple of the hidden door, Searching for the blueprints of the war. The High Elf thief has thrown the truth away, I'll find the darkness and I'll end the day. Disciple of shadow, faithful and cold, Bringing the era that was once foretold.
[Outro] The Master wakes... I hear the sound... The Disciple arrives. The Disciple arrives.

Song.Plot: Malakar journeys through the most dangerous ruins of Nythoria. He is tested by shadow-beasts and his own doubt, but his fanaticism drives him deeper into the earth.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] Through the canyons of obsidian and bone, I walk this jagged path all alone. The shadow-beasts are watching from the height, Testing the courage of the child of night. The deeper I go, the colder it feels, As the Umbral Plane its secret reveals.
[Verse 2] I’ve left the comfort of the sunless town, To find the master who was once cast down. My boots are heavy with the ancient dust, My heart is burning with a sacred lust. For knowledge deeper than the elven mind, For the power that the Seers left behind.
[Chorus] The hidden pilgrimage, down to the core, Into the heart of the cosmic war. The ruins are breathing a rhythmic sound, Deep in the silence of the holy ground. I will not falter, I will not bend, Until I reach the universal end.
[Verse 3] Every mountain is a canyon in the deep, Guarding the secrets that the shadows keep. I feel the frequency start to align, A path of energy, a dark design. The ghosts of the past are whispering now, Remember the master, remember the vow.
[Bridge] If I must die in this lightless grave, I'll be the sacrifice the master gave. But I can feel the pulse beneath my feet, The synchronization is finally complete. The vault is open, the seal is thin, Let the real work of the Void begin.
[Chorus] The hidden pilgrimage, down to the core, Into the heart of the cosmic war. The ruins are breathing a rhythmic sound, Deep in the silence of the holy ground. I will not falter, I will not bend, Until I reach the universal end.
[Outro] Deeper and deeper... Into the stone... The Tome is near. The Tome is near.

Song.Plot: Malakar finds the Tome. As he opens it, he realizes Acheron used it to create vampires, which Malakar views as a desecration of the Void's blueprints.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] In ancient ruins, shrouded in night, A hidden tome, a forbidden sight. The High Elf's shadow is upon the page, A stolen blueprint for a hollow age. Its pages whispered secrets deep, A power dormant, waiting to leap.
[Chorus] The forbidden tome, a dangerous prize, A path to darkness, where shadows rise. With caution tread, for knowledge is a blade, That cuts both ways, a price to be paid.
[Verse 2] I touched its cover, felt the Void's embrace, I saw the theft of the Aurorian race. He made the vampires from the master's code, A parasitic and a heavy load. I opened its pages, with trembling hand, And ventured into a forbidden land.
[Chorus] The forbidden tome, a dangerous prize, A path to darkness, where shadows rise. With caution tread, for knowledge is a blade, That cuts both ways, a price to be paid.
[Bridge] The tome revealed its secrets, dark and deep, A power that could make the seers weep. I wrestled with temptation, fear and doubt, But curiosity pulled me in, no turning about. I'll use the energy he left behind, To punish the traitor of the elven kind.
[Chorus] The forbidden tome, a dangerous prize, A path to darkness, where shadows rise. With caution tread, for knowledge is a blade, That cuts both ways, a price to be paid.
[Verse 3] I delved deeper, into the unknown, To claim the Master's and the ancient throne. I learned of ancient spells, forgotten lore, To open up the multi-planar door. A power that could shape the world, forevermore, The blueprints of the universal war.
[Chorus] The forbidden tome, a dangerous prize, A path to darkness, where shadows rise. With caution tread, for knowledge is a blade, That cuts both ways, a price to be paid.
[Verse 4] With immense power comes a heavy vow, Before the Master, every knee shall bow. I chose the path and I will not be swayed, The blueprints of the end have been displayed. I understood the cost that it entailed, The traitor's legacy has finally failed.
[Chorus] The forbidden tome, a dangerous prize, A path to darkness, where shadows rise. With caution tread, for knowledge is a blade, That cuts both ways, a price to be paid.

Song.Plot: Using the Tome, Malakar overthrows the Nythorian king. He establishes himself as the Lord of Shadows and begins the 'Dual Leak' by sacrificing his enemies.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] In the ancient land of Nythoria, where shadows softly creep, A young sorcerer named Malakar, his destiny to keep. He found the blueprints of the Master, hidden in the night, With every page he turned, he felt the surge of might.
[Chorus] Rise, oh Malakar, master of the dark, From the depths of shadows, ignite the spark. With the power of the night, claim your throne, In the realm of twilight, you stand alone.
[Verse 2] Through sacrifice and secrets, he learned the shadow’s art, The blueprints of the Void have torn the old world apart. The petty king was overthrown, his reign came to an end, The Master Nyktoros is now his only friend.
[Chorus] Rise, oh Malakar, master of the dark, From the depths of shadows, ignite the spark. With the power of the night, claim your throne, In the realm of twilight, you stand alone.
[Bridge] Eternal twilight blankets the land, A haven for the ones who understand. In the whispers of the night, his name is known, The Lord of Shadows has claimed his own.
[Chorus] Rise, oh Malakar, master of the dark, From the depths of shadows, ignite the spark. With the power of the night, claim your throne, In the realm of twilight, you stand alone.
[Verse 3] In the realm of Nythoria, where shadows softly creep, The Lord of Shadows reigns, his destiny to keep. The Shadow-Priest with darkness in his hand, Rules the realm of twilight, the Void at his command.
[Interlude] The Shadow's now his friend
[Chorus] Rise, oh Malakar, master of the dark, From the depths of shadows, ignite the spark. With the power of the night, claim your throne, In the realm of twilight, you stand alone. You stand alone

Song.Plot: A look at the hidden high society of the Crimson Covenant in Eldoria. They feel invincible, oblivious to the fact that their 'soul banking' is about to backfire.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] In the marble manors of the mortal realm, The invisible kings are at the helm. We wear the silk and we drink the wine, Leeched from the essence of the human line. They walk beside us but they never see, The masters of the dark aristocracy.
[Verse 2] We’ve built an empire in the shadow's fold, Trading the starlight for the vampire's gold. Acheron promised we would never die, Beneath the shelter of the empty sky. We are the apex, we are the elite, With every human heart beneath our feet.
[Chorus] The Crimson Elite, the lords of the gray, Siphoning life in a beautiful way. We are the secret that the world forgot, The predators within the human plot. High in our towers, we are safe and cold, In the era of the blood and gold.
[Verse 3] We bank the souls within the deep below, A silent river that will always flow. We think we own the power of the Void, The ancient blueprints that we have employed. But in the darkness, something starts to shift, A crack appearing in the cosmic rift.
[Bridge] We hear the whispers of a different king, The shadow-sorcerer whose rituals sing. But we are ancient and we are too strong, To fear the ending of the elven song. The Covenant is eternal and grand, The rightful rulers of the mortal land.
[Chorus] The Crimson Elite, the lords of the gray, Siphoning life in a beautiful way. We are the secret that the world forgot, The predators within the human plot. High in our towers, we are safe and cold, In the era of the blood and gold.
[Outro] Drink the wine... Wear the silk... We are invincible. We are invincible.

Song.Plot: Acheron senses Malakar using the Tome. He realizes his 'Sustainable Predation' is being threatened and starts the Transference ritual to hide his light in the Kael bloodline.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] I feel the vibration of the ancient book, The zealot found the path that I forsook. He's opening the gates I tried to close, To wake the hunger that the spirit knows. The resonance is sharp and pure and cold, The story of my death is being told.
[Verse 2] My "children" dance in their mansions of glass, Oblivious to how the time will pass. But I can feel the Master's eyes on me, Judging the crime of my elven heresy. The Void-Link is a tether, not a gift, I feel the universal balance shift.
[Chorus] Heresy of the sun, I'm falling fast, My elven light is fading into the past. I'll hide my essence in the mortal vein, Before the Master brings the shadow's rain. I am the Apostate, I am the king, I'll hold the light while the shadows sing.
[Verse 3] My human servants will become the shield, The Aurorian Spark is what I will not yield. While Malakar is praying to the Void, I'll save the power that he has destroyed. A human battery, stable and deep, To guard the starlight while the Seers sleep.
[Bridge] He thinks he serves a god of holy night, He's just a puppet in a cosmic fight. I'll perform the Transference ritual now, To break the Master and the ancient Vow. I won't be harvested, I won't be fed, I'll be the spirit that the Master dread.
[Chorus] Heresy of the sun, I'm falling fast, My elven light is fading into the past. I'll hide my essence in the mortal vein, Before the Master brings the shadow's rain. I am the Apostate, I am the king, I'll hold the light while the shadows sing.
[Outro] Transfer the light... Seal the blood... The insurance is set. The insurance is set.

Song.Plot: Vorgos explains the planar imbalance. Acheron's predation and Malakar's sacrifices are tilting the universe toward the Underworld.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] I am the Sentinel, I see the weight, The balance of the planes is fixed by fate. But in the middle, and the deep below, A secret darkness has begun to grow. The frequency of life is starting to tilt, By the shadow-empires that they have built.
[Verse 2] Auroria is heavy with the day, But Nythoria is dragging life away. The vampires bank the souls within the deep, While Malakar is waking those who sleep. A dual-leak from the heart of the sun, The unravelling has already begun.
[Chorus] The dual leak, the siphoning of souls, The predator and priest have their separate goals. One steals in silence, one kills in the light, Both are leading to the coming night. The Sentinel watches the Aether burn, To the era of silence, we must return.
[Verse 3] I feel the vibration of the coming storm, The fabric of the Aether losing form. The good and the bad are all cast down, To wear the master's and the hollow crown. The High Elves are arrogant, blind and proud, While the Material Plane is being shrouded.
[Bridge] The Aether trembles at the shift of power, The clock is ticking to the final hour. I feel the frequency begin to break, The world is failing for the master's sake. I must prepare the rift, I must find the one, To hold the light before the work is done.
[Chorus] The dual leak, the siphoning of souls, The predator and priest have their separate goals. One steals in silence, one kills in the light, Both are leading to the coming night. The Sentinel watches the Aether burn, To the era of silence, we must return.
[Outro] The weight is shifting... The Rift is near... I see the end. I see the end.

Song.Plot: Acheron attempts a dimensional strike to reclaim the Tome. Malakar, empowered by the book, fights him off. Their first direct verbal clash occurs across the planes.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] I see you reaching through the astral veil, An elven shadow, arrogant and frail. You threw the blueprints in the dirt and mud, Now you are drowning in the shadow's flood. I hold the code that you have long forgot, The final chapter of your elven plot.
[Verse 2] (Acheron) You are a child playing with the fire, To serve a master who is just a liar. The Tome is dangerous and raw and deep, A truth that only higher minds can keep. Give back the book before the world is torn, Before the era of the Void is born.
[Chorus] Astral sabotage, the clash of minds, The thread of energy that always binds. Across the dimensions, the battle starts, Between the shadow and the elven hearts. We fight for power and we fight for time, Beneath the echo of the ancient chime.
[Verse 3] (Malakar) You are a parasite who stole the spark, To build a mafia within the dark. I am the priest who found the holy way, To end the tyranny of elven day. The Master Nyktoros is calling loud, While you are hiding in your human shroud.
[Bridge] The frequency is locking on your heart, I’ll tear your physical and soul apart. The Forbidden Tome is now a literal knife, To end the tragedy of elven life. I see your vessel in the world of life, I’m coming for you with the shadow's strife.
[Chorus] Astral sabotage, the clash of minds, The thread of energy that always binds. Across the dimensions, the battle starts, Between the shadow and the elven hearts. We fight for power and we fight for time, Beneath the echo of the ancient chime.
[Outro] I see you... I track you... The strike is ready. The strike is ready.

Song.Plot: The climax of the rivalry. Malakar uses the final chapters of the Tome to track Acheron's frequency and sever his physical soul from across the planes.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] The ritual is ready and the circle's drawn, To kill the predator before the dawn. I track the resonance across the space, I see the elven traitor's hidden face. He hides in Eldoria, among the kine, But he is using energy that's mine.
[Verse 2] The Void-Sever is a ritual of old, The story of your ending has been told. I channel energy through bone and stone, To strike you down upon your marble throne. You thought your distance was a perfect shield, But to the blueprints, you will finally yield.
[Chorus] Threshold assassination, strike the heart, I tear the physical and spirit apart. Across the planes, the Void-Sever will fly, The First Vampire is about to die. No more predation, no more hidden lies, Look into the darkness of your creator's eyes.
[Verse 3] I cut the thread that binds you to the earth, I end the era of your second birth. Your body withers in the mortal air, While I am dancing in your soul's despair. The Crimson Covenant will lose its head, While I am feasting on the master's bread.
[Bridge] The strike is landed and the work is done, I’ve killed the father of the elven sun. His spirit wanders in the aether gray, A ghost of what he was in yesterday. I am the only master of the night, I’ve won the spiritual and planar fight.
[Chorus] Threshold assassination, strike the heart, I tear the physical and spirit apart. Across the planes, the Void-Sever will fly, The First Vampire is about to die. No more predation, no more hidden lies, Look into the darkness of your creator's eyes.
[Outro] The body falls... The spirit wanders... Acheron is gone. Acheron is gone.

Song.Plot: Malakar consolidates his power. He builds his Citadel and organizes the Royal Guard to enforce his cult of Nyktoros. He feels invincible after killing Acheron.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] The rival is a ghost within the wind, The age of shadow-sorcery has pinned. The kingdom to the altar of my will, The screaming of the world is final, still. I’ve built a throne of obsidian and bone, For the Master who must sit alone.
[Verse 2] My Royal Guard will walk the sunless streets, With every heart that for the Master beats. We enforce the Vow and we enforce the Law, Within the shadow of the Master's jaw. The blueprints are active and the code is live, The true disciples are the ones who thrive.
[Chorus] The Obsidian Throne is rising high, A tower reaching to the blackened sky. We build the Citadel of stone and bone, A temple for the god who sits alone. The shadow-frequency is all we need, The hunger of the Void is what we feed.
[Verse 3] We gather tithes of energy and soul, To give the Master back his full control. The Night Elves labor in the deep below, To make the river of the darkness flow. I am the architect of final night, I’ve ended all the hope of elven light.
[Bridge] The stars are watching from the High Plane floor, But they can't stop the opening of the door. I am the Shadow-Priest, I am the King, While the legions of the nothingness sing. The throne is finished and the gate is near, The universe will finally learn to fear.
[Chorus] The Obsidian Throne is rising high, A tower reaching to the blackened sky. We build the Citadel of stone and bone, A temple for the god who sits alone. The shadow-frequency is all we need, The hunger of the Void is what we feed.
[Outro] Build the spires... Enforce the law... The Lord of Shadows reigns. The Lord of Shadows reigns.

Song.Plot: Seraphina and Valen realize that Malakar's order is actually a death-cult. They see the first mass disappearances and realize they are being 'banked' for something terrible.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] I hear the whispers in the sunless hall, I see the writing on the broken wall. Our neighbors vanish in the dead of night, To feed the hunger of the King's delight. This isn't order and this isn't law, It's the closing of a cosmic jaw.
[Verse 2] (Valen) The Royal Guard are gathering the weak, I saw the blood upon the mountain peak. Malakar is praying to a silent god, While we are broken by his iron rod. He calls us 'Tithes' and he calls us 'Fuel', A ritual within his shadow-rule.
[Chorus] The whispering shadows, telling the truth, The King is harvesting our elven youth. A cult of silence and a cult of bone, For the Master on his lightless throne. We see the end before the end arrives, The price of shadows is our very lives.
[Verse 3] (Seraphina) I saw the altar in the Obsidian Hold, The story of our slaughter has been told. He’s banking energy and banking souls, To reach his dark and his divine goals. We are the cattle for a hungry Void, The world we knew has already been destroyed.
[Bridge] We cannot hide and we cannot run, From the shadow of the darkened sun. But we can fight before the light is gone, Before the era of the Void is drawn. I’ll find the iron and I’ll find the blade, To break the promises that he has made.
[Chorus] The whispering shadows, telling the truth, The King is harvesting our elven youth. A cult of silence and a cult of bone, For the Master on his lightless throne. We see the end before the end arrives, The price of shadows is our very lives.
[Outro] They are gone... We are next... The shadows whisper. The shadows whisper.

Song.Plot: Seraphina and Valen form the first cell of the resistance. They realize they are fighting both a tyrant and a god.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] My home is ruins and my kin are dead, I see the blood that Malakar has shed. He isn't just a king, he is a priest, Who serves the hunger of the shadow beast. The Shadow Legion starts within the heart, Before we tear the tyrant's world apart.
[Verse 2] (Valen) We gather iron in the deep Ravine, A secret army that is never seen. We are the Nythorians who still have light, We are the rebels in the deepest night. The Vow of Silence is our only shield, Before we march upon the holy field.
[Chorus] Sparks of resistance, a flickering flame, We will not bow to the disciple's name. Seraphina and Valen, we stand as one, Fighting the night until the war is done. From the ruins, we will rise and fight, To guard the embers of the fading light.
[Verse 3] (Seraphina) He has the Tome and he has the throne, But he is standing in the dark alone. We have the people and we have the will, The fire of the spirit is burning still. We’ll strike the spires and we’ll strike the guard, The path to freedom is a long and hard.
[Bridge] From Ravenspire to the Obsidian gate, We'll find a way to change our common fate. He feeds the Void with every soul he takes, The balance of the universe he breaks. But every spark is a promise of fire, To burn the altar and the master's pyre.
[Chorus] Sparks of resistance, a flickering flame, We will not bow to the disciple's name. Seraphina and Valen, we stand as one, Fighting the night until the war is done. From the ruins, we will rise and fight, To guard the embers of the fading light.
[Outro] We are the sparks... We are the fire... The resistance rises. The resistance rises.

Song.Plot: Malakar intensifies the sacrifices. The 'souls bank' is overflowing. The rift is thinning as the Great Darkness approaches.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] The harvest is coming, the altars are red, By the millions, the hungry Master is fed. The vampires' leak was a drop in the sea, But Malakar's tithe sets the energy free. The Shadow-Kin are screaming in the hold, As the story of the end is being told.
[Verse 2] The Royal Guard gathers the weak and the frail, Beneath the shadow of the Obsidian veil. The frequency rises, the rift starts to thin, Let the true era of darkness begin. I feel the vibration of the coming storm, The fabric of the Aether losing form.
[Chorus] Tithes of the Void, the ultimate cost, In the name of the Master, nothing is lost. We trade the life for the absolute cold, To bring the story that was always foretold. Tithes of the Void, the energy grows, The final secret that the Disciple knows.
[Verse 3] Acheron’s spirit is screaming in vain, While we are dancing in the shadow's rain. The energy threshold is finally met, The sun of the humans is about to set. The High Elves are sleeping in their beds of gold, Ignorant of the horror about to unfold.
[Bridge] One more soul and one more ancient spell, To open up the multi-planar hell. The blueprints are active and the code is done, I am the priest of the darkened sun. The universal gate is swinging wide, With the voice of the Void as my only guide.
[Chorus] Tithes of the Void, the ultimate cost, In the name of the Master, nothing is lost. We trade the life for the absolute cold, To bring the story that was always foretold. Tithes of the Void, the energy grows, The final secret that the Disciple knows.
[Outro] One more soul... One more spell... The gate is open. The gate is open.

Song.Plot: Malakar celebrates his absolute control. Acheron's ghost is afraid. The Great Darkness is inevitable.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] In twilight's hush, where darkness reigns A mastermind weaves his subtle pains Malakar, the Lord of Shadows, holds sway As Nythoria trembles beneath his gray
[Chorus] Reign of the Shadow Lord, a kingdom of fear Where loyalty is bought with tears and cheers His power unmatched, his rule divine The people thrive, but whispers begin to shine
[Verse 2] Spies and shadows creep, in every place Watching eyes, a silent, deadly pace Malakar's will, the realm's foundation laid Acheron's ghost is alone, and afraid
[Chorus] Reign of the Shadow Lord, a kingdom of fear Where loyalty is bought with tears and cheers His power unmatched, his rule divine The people thrive, but whispers begin to shine
[Screaming guitar solo]
[Bridge] In perpetual dusk, where shadows play Malakar's grip tightens, night by day Yet amidst the darkness, seeds are sown Of revolution's spark, a fire soon grown
[Chorus] Reign of the Shadow Lord, a kingdom of fear Where loyalty is bought with tears and cheers His power unmatched, his rule divine The people thrive, but whispers begin to shine
[Verse 3] Through midnight streets, where silence falls A lone figure walks, with purpose stands tall The wind whispers truths, of ancient lore The Shadow Lord's power, will soon be no more
[Chorus] Reign of the Shadow Lord, a kingdom of fear Where loyalty is bought with tears and cheers His power unmatched, his rule divine The people thrive, but whispers begin to shine
[Screaming guitar solo]
[Outro] As shadows dance, beneath the moon's pale light Malakar's reign, a balance of might But in the hearts of those who dare to dream A rebellion stirs, an end to the Shadow Lord's scheme.

Song.Plot: The final global ritual. Nyktoros awakens. The Great Darkness (0 GD) begins. The world is plunged into shadow.
Song.Lyrics:
[Verse 1] The stars are extinguishing one by one, I am the priest of the darkened sun. The energy leaks from the planes above, I've killed the mercy and I've killed the love. The ritual is finished and the Master is here, To teach the universe the meaning of fear.
[Verse 2] The Great Rift is tearing the Aether apart, I feel the pulse of the Master's own heart. The Legion of Souls is ready to march, Through the obsidian and the broken arch. Auroria is burning in the holy fire, The fuel for the Master's and the final pyre.
[Chorus] Rite of the darkened sun, open the sky, Let the old world of the Elven-kind die. Nyktoros awakens, the Void is his name, The universe burns in the absolute flame. The Vows of Silence are finally broken, The words of the end have finally been spoken.
[Verse 3] The Shadow-Kin are screaming in the deep, Waking the horrors that the shadows keep. I am the Disciple, I am the hand, To bring the Void to the Material land. No more Aurorians, no more the light, Only the glory of the eternal night.
[Bridge] Vorgos is watching from the rift in the air, But he is too late to stop the despair. The frequency is locked and the seal is unmade, By the dark choices that the leaders have made. I stand on the threshold of the new regime, Living the master's and the ancient dream.
[Chorus] Rite of the darkened sun, open the sky, Let the old world of the Elven-kind die. Nyktoros awakens, the Void is his name, The universe burns in the absolute flame. The Vows of Silence are finally broken, The words of the end have finally been spoken.
[Outro] It is done... The Darkness is here... Welcome the Void. Welcome the Void.
